name: Gurabo (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Green field with five diagonal yellow bands whose upper edges are indented like stairways, recalling the town's famous steps.
history: Gurabo is a town and municipality in eastern Puerto Rico, known for its steep streets of steps; according to Flags of the World the flag consists of a green field with five stairways in yellow.

features.role: five indented diagonal bands forming stairways
